races.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: MEHMAR only just failed to justify sustained support starting out for his new yard when second at Southwell 31 days ago, splitting a pair of next-time-out winners in the process. He remains very well handicapped on the back of 4 lb rise based on past exploits and rates a major player from a handy draw. Black Missile also arrives on the back of a solid effort and is next best, whilst Knicks has the ability to play a part if putting it all together, too. MEHMAR (IRE) BLACK MISSILE (IRE) KNICKS (IRE)

races.title: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict: PROSEWRITER did well under the circumstances and looked a good prospect to boot when making a winning debut in a Southwell novice 4 weeks ago. Well-bred and open to improvement, he may well be up to defying a penalty and go 2-2. Gombey Rhythm cost plenty at the breeze-ups last year and the booking of Billy Loughnane signals intent ahead of debut. Baandee and Flag of Nations complete the dangers. PROSEWRITER (IRE) GOMBEY RHYTHM BAANDEE

races.title: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: ZAJAL hails from a fine family and showed plenty when chasing home one who is undoubtedly destined for pattern class in a Doncaster maiden on debut 32 days ago. He looks sure to progress and is fancied to confirm the promise of that run here. Manolin and Manitoba also shaped promisingly on debut and head up the dangers. ZAJAL MANOLIN MANITOBA

races.title: All Weather Championship Is Back EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: The betting will no doubt prove informative but MODERNIST fetched a lofty sum as a yearling and makes plenty of appeal for leading connections, so he could be the way to go under Colin Keane. Haldon Fire sets a good standard on his promising Southwell debut second and can put that experience to good use. Mythical Tale and Top Scholar are other likely-looking improvers following their respective opening effort. MODERNIST HALDON FIRE MYTHICAL TALE (IRE)

races.title: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery (GBBPlusRace)
races.verdict: NATIONAL PRIDE took a big step forward on his first venture into nursery company when an emphatic Chelmsford scorer and is fancied to make light of a 5 lb higher mark with this step up in distance a positive too. High Calibre is also weighted to have a say and rates next best ahead of nursery debutant Happy Love . NATIONAL PRIDE (IRE) HIGH CALIBRE HAPPY LOVE (GER)
races.bettingForecast: National Pride (11/8), High Calibre (5/2), Happy Love (4/1), Capricious Star (9/2)

races.title: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
races.verdict: SILENT STRIKE got his career firmly back having been gelded during his 4-month absence when staying on late for third over C&D 5 weeks ago and, with that form worthy of viewing positively, certainly in relation to those in the frame, he could be worth chancing to build on that. Another Abbot , Dandana and Bolo Neighs head up the dangers in a good quality heat. SILENT STRIKE (IRE) ANOTHER ABBOT (IRE) DANDANA

races.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict: ENOLA GREY has been shaping up well from her reduced mark and might prove the answer to this competitive fillies' handicap. Chantelle is another who has offered plenty of promise in her recent starts and is second choice ahead of Ghisa and Queen Tamara . ENOLA GREY (IRE) CHANTELLE GHISA (IRE)

races.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict: FLAGBEARER makes obvious appeal as an unexposed 3-y-o from a leading stable and he can make a successful start to his handicap career. Must Believe added to his strong record on all-weather when scoring at Chelmsford under Billy Loughnane 19 days ago and is second choice ahead of Codiak . FLAGBEARER MUST BELIEVE CODIAK (IRE)

races.title: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap
races.verdict: A case can be made for a few of these but CAMPENAERTS is proving progressive for Jonathan Portman and is taken to make light of a 6 lb rise for his comfortable Nottingham success and bag a second C&D victory. In-form C&D winner Maharajas Express could emerge as the chief threat with Billy Loughnane in the saddle, although Rye and Sunlit Sea can also play a prominent role. CAMPENAERTS MAHARAJAS EXPRESS RYE
